summary: Implementation plan for Bus Fever 3D: Traffic Escape covering Dynamic Day/Sunset/Night Lighting, Open-Source CC0 Multi-Zone Surface Textures (Asphalt, Cobblestone Plaza, Tiled Walkway, Landscaped Turf), Dark-Mode Menus & HUD (Zero White Backgrounds), Open-Source SFX + Toggleable Background Music Loop, and Full TV Remote & 4-Controller Gamepad Spatial Navigation.
